_comment: Hand-written cases for workflow.PathKey, whose doc owns the rule; TestPathKey_SharedFixture and run-node-key.node.test.ts read every case.

cases.name: a plain step path joins verbatim
slash pair one: a slash in the container id
slash pair two: a slash in the step id
slash pair three: no slash in any id
a colon inside an id is escaped
a backslash inside an id is escaped
a space and a hash are not separators
an unplaced step is its bare id
